text:
Jamie (CS): Heads up — NorthBay Health just finished week 2 of onboarding and dropped a set of feature asks in the NBD onboarding report. Copying the list here for triage.
Priya (CS): sharing the parsed list I pulled from the call notes: 1) per-route billing visibility, 2) instant export for compliance reports, 3) per-user rate limits for admin roles, 4) better webhook retry logic.
Ethan (Support): +1 on webhook retries — customer hit it twice this week, outage impact small but noisy. Support ticket #S-3982.
Nina (Onboarding): They repeatedly said the CSV export is slowing their compliance sign-off — they need exports in < 2 min. Right now it hits ~8–10m during peak.
Ravi (PM): Thanks. Can you paste the exact quote from the customer? I want to be precise in the request to eng.
Jamie (CS): "We can't get compliance sign-off until exports are reliably under 2 minutes during daily runs. It's blocking our production go-live." — from the onboarding call (Emma, NorthBay).
Priya (CS): Suggest we score asks using Impact x Effort and tag renewal risk. Proposed quick rubric: Impact (High/Med/Low), Effort (T-shirt: S/M/L), Renewal Risk (Y/N).
Ravi (PM): Good. I'll take webhook retry and export perf for initial scoping. Can you add basic context: frequency, affected routes, sample payload sizes?
Ethan (Support): Frequency: exports run nightly, ~3000 rows, avg payload 1.2MB. Webhook failures: ~2% of calls during a 1hr window on 2026-02-11 (S-3982 logs).
Jamie (CS): I'll attach the NBD notes and the customer's CSV sample to the feedback doc: https://docs.redwood.com/cs/feedback/northbay-week2 (internal).
redwoodbot: Reminder: please add a product-ticket link when assigning to Ravi.
Priya (CS): Quick vote from CS: exports perf = High impact / M effort / Renewal risk = Y. Webhook retries = Med impact / S effort / Renewal risk = N. Per-route billing visibility = Med impact / M effort / Renewal risk = Y. Per-user rate limits = Low impact / S effort / Renewal risk = N.
Ravi (PM): I'll create two tickets: RDW-4321 (export perf) and RDW-4322 (webhook retry policy). Will do a spike for export perf (2-3d).
Jamie (CS): Can we get an ETA for the spike and a rough go/no-go to communicate to NorthBay?
Ravi (PM): Spike starts Monday; expect write-up + PoC by EOD Wednesday. If PoC shows <2min with batching + stream export, we can plan a sprint work item for the next cycle.
Nina (Onboarding): I'll let the customer know we have a spike starting next week and ask them to share the largest export run they have.
Ethan (Support): I'll link S-3982 and include logs in RDW-4322 when it's created.
Priya (CS): Action items summary: 1) Jamie attach notes and sample CSV, 2) Ravi create tickets + run spike, 3) Ethan attach support logs, 4) Nina coordinate sample from customer.
Jamie (CS): putting in calendar: quick sync Friday 10am to review spike results and prioritization if available. :calendar:
Ravi (PM): thanks all. tagging for visibility @Ravi @Jamie @Priya.
Priya (CS): Closing loop here — will add the Impact x Effort tags in our feedback tracker so product can filter renewal-risk flagged items. :white_check_mark:
